description: This file defines the CandidateDecorator class within a recruitment plugin, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve data related to candidate entities, such as setting the adding employee and formatting application date.

classes.name: CandidateDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Candidate entity, adding helper methods for setting related employee info and formatting application date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a Candidate object.

methods.name: setAddedPersonById
methods.description: Sets the 'added person' (employee) for the candidate by employee ID.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the candidate's date of application formatted as a string.
